jobs.title: Affiliate and Partnerships Manager, Performance Marketing
jobs.description:
About Step

Step's mission is to improve the financial future of the next generation. Millions of people use our banking and borrowing products to manage, build, and grow their money. Now that we're part of Beast Industries – the company behind MrBeast – we're poised for a new phase of growth to deliver financial literacy and tools at massive scale.

About the Role

As a member of the Performance Marketing team, this role owns Step's affiliate and partner marketing program end-to-end. You'll manage and scale our presence on affiliate networks like Impact, recruit and onboard new partners, launch our creator affiliate network, build the tracking infrastructure that makes performance measurable, and optimize commission structures and placements to drive efficient acquisition. Equally important, you'll build and grow a portfolio of direct partnerships that operate entirely outside of affiliate networks, identifying distribution opportunities, negotiating custom deals, and structuring programs from scratch with publishers, creators, brands, and emerging platforms. You'll own the full commercial and operational lifecycle of every partnership, from pricing negotiations and contract execution through invoicing, budget management, creative approvals, and QA tracking. This role is right for someone who can close a deal, build a program, and keep the operational engine running behind it all.

In this role, you will:

- Own and scale Step's affiliate program on Impact and other relevant networks, recruiting and onboarding new partners across publishers, cashback platforms, comparison sites, and content creators, and continuously optimizing commission structures, placements, and incentives to improve CAC

- Build, launch, and scale the affiliate creator program at the company backed by the biggest creator on Earth

- Negotiate pricing, payout terms, and deal parameters across all partnership types, and manage the end-to-end contract process including coordinating reviews, approvals, and maintaining records of all active agreements

- Build and manage a portfolio of direct partnerships outside of affiliate networks, owning the full process from cold outreach through deal negotiation, program design, and ongoing management, spanning publishers, newsletters, media properties, and co-marketing campaigns

- Develop Step's presence in emerging distribution channels, including AI-driven discovery and recommendation surfaces, identifying and securing placements as these platforms grow in reach and influence

- Work with creators and influencers on longer-term direct partnership arrangements, managing relationships, deliverables, and performance outside of a traditional affiliate model

- Own invoicing and budget management for the program, approving partner invoices, reconciling payouts against performance, and keeping spend tracked and on budget

- Build and maintain tracking setups across all partners, ensuring accurate attribution and clean data, and conduct regular QA to catch discrepancies, broken links, and attribution errors before they affect reporting or payouts

- Lead creative development for partner assets, own the review and approval process for brand and regulatory compliance, monitor placements for FTC violations and off-brand activity, and partner with legal on financial-product marketing claims.

- Report on program performance regularly, translating partner-level data into clear takeaways and recommendations for the broader growth team.

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- 4+ years of experience managing affiliate or partner marketing programs, ideally at a consumer app, fintech, or growth-stage startup

- Hands-on experience with impact or a comparable affiliate network, including program setup, partner onboarding, tracking configuration, and commission management

- Demonstrated experience building direct partnership programs from scratch, including identifying the right partners, negotiating deal structures, and executing contracts through to completion

- Comfortable owning program financials, including budget tracking, invoice approvals, and payout reconciliation across a large and varied partner set

- Strong understanding of affiliate and partnership tracking mechanics, including link attribution, postback setups, pixel-based tracking, and MMP integrations, with hands-on experience conducting tracking QA and resolving attribution issues. Experience with AppsFlyer or a comparable MMP is a plus, as is familiarity with GA4

- Experience managing creative development and approval workflows with a strong grasp of brand standards, FTC disclosure rules, and financial marketing compliance, and a sharp eye for fraud and non-compliant promotional activity

- Familiarity with creator and influencer partnership models and how they complement a broader affiliate and direct partnership program

- Strong communicator and relationship builder, comfortable managing partners at all levels from independent creators to large media companies, and analytical and organized enough to manage a high volume of partners, contracts, and projects while making clear decisions from performance data

Logistics

Location:   Remote (US) or San Mateo, CA, with occasional travel for team offsites and key meetings

Education:  Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box, and we'd rather meet you than miss you.

How we're different

We stand for the side hustlers, the creators, the freelancers, and the investors — people who are not afraid to take on challenges, especially when it comes to their finances. Step is focused on disrupting the banking industry by delivering a differentiated, mobile-first consumer experience, and we operate like the customers we serve: customer obsessed, acting as owners, moving with urgency, and breaking the norm.

Step is a wholly owned subsidiary of  Beast Industries , the media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson (MrBeast), the most-watched person in the world. Beast Industries spans digital media, consumer products, philanthropy, and new ventures, with an audience reach no consumer company has ever had — and Step is tasked with turning that reach into financial literacy and tools for the next generation at massive scale. With Beast's distribution and brand behind it, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12 months, and joining now means helping shape that trajectory from the inside.

Come work with us!

Step is a remote-first company building banking for the next generation. We offer competitive compensation and stock options, generous medical, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance, a 401k plan with Safe Harbor company matching, a flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays, 12 weeks paid parental leave with flexible return to work, and a company-provided technology package. If you're looking to join a fast-growing company with a strong mission and vision that puts people first, we want to meet you!

Step is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Step is committed to providing reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the application and interview process. If you need an accommodation, please let us know at people@step.com and we'll work with you to provide appropriate support.

jobs.title: Director, Marketing Technology
jobs.description:
About Step

Step's mission is to improve the financial future of the next generation. Millions of people use our banking and borrowing products to manage, build, and grow their money. Now that we're part of Beast Industries – the company behind MrBeast – we're poised for a new phase of growth to deliver financial literacy and tools at massive scale.

About the Role

Marketing at Step runs on data. Every acquisition channel, lifecycle campaign, rewards drop, and measurement decision depends on clean, connected, well-modeled data flowing between our product, our warehouse, and a dozen marketing platforms. Today, much of that work lands on engineering. We're hiring a Director, Marketing Technology, to own it end-to-end.

This is a deeply technical, hands-on role for someone with a software or data engineering background who wants to apply that skill set to growth. You'll be the architect and operator of Step's marketing technology stack: owning our ad channel and attribution integrations, managing our vendor ecosystem (Segment, AppsFlyer, Braze, Funnel, and others), building the data models and analytical tooling the marketing team runs on, and shipping the monthly rewards and offers that drive engagement. You'll act as the bridge between Marketing, Product, and Engineering taking on the technical work that currently pulls engineers away from the core product, and raising the bar on what marketing can measure, automate, and personalize.

You'll start as a hands-on individual contributor with the opportunity to build and lead a marketing technology team as the function scales.

In this role, you will:

Own the marketing technology stack

- Own the architecture, roadmap, and day-to-day operation of Step's martech ecosystem including CDP, MMP, lifecycle messaging, data aggregation, and analytics tooling along with the documentation, QA, and governance standards that keep it reliable and privacy-compliant

- Manage all marketing technology partners (Segment, AppsFlyer, Braze, Funnel, and similar), including evaluation, implementation, optimization, and contract/renewal input

Build and optimize ad channel and measurement integrations

- Configure, validate, and maintain integrations with paid channels (Meta, Google, TikTok, and similar), including server-side conversion APIs, event schemas, setup counting methods, attribution windows, and first-party audience syncs

- Own attribution and mobile measurement (AppsFlyer/Segment): SKAN/postback configuration, conversion windows, deduplication, and channel-level data quality

- Partner on GA4 implementation including event taxonomy, funnel conversion configuration, and custom reporting; leveraging GA4 data to fill attribution gaps across channels and inform incrementality analysis

Be the data backbone of the marketing team

- Build and maintain the pipelines and data models that power marketing reporting, audience segmentation, and campaign measurement  with identity, event, and audience definitions kept consistent across product, warehouse, and activation platforms

- Develop self-serve analytical tools, dashboards, and automations so marketers can answer their own questions (ie. spend pacing, funnel conversion, LTV, incrementality)

Ship marketing programs

- Own the technical build of Step's monthly rewards and offers program end to end targeting logic, delivery, tracking, and post-campaign readout

- Support lifecycle and CRM campaign execution in Braze: triggers and data feeds

Partner across the company

- Serve as marketing's technical counterpart to Product, Engineering, and Data scoping requests, setting priorities, and taking build work off engineering's plate

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- 7+ years across software engineering, data engineering, or marketing technology, with meaningful time spent as a hands-on engineer

- Proven experience owning a modern martech stack at a consumer company: CDP (Segment or similar), MMP (AppsFlyer, Adjust, or Branch), and lifecycle platforms (Braze or similar)

- Strong SQL and working proficiency in a scripting language (Python or JavaScript); comfortable with APIs, webhooks, event-driven architectures, and cloud data warehouses

- Deep understanding of mobile and web attribution: conversion APIs, SKAdNetwork, postbacks, deduplication, and incrementality

- A clear communicator who bridges marketing, engineering, and executive audiences

- You are hungry for action and you'd rather ship a working solution this week than a perfect one next quarter

- Experience operating martech at larger scale, ideally through viral moments or campaign-driven traffic spikes

Some of the technology we use:

- Kotlin

- gRPC

- Protocol Buffers

- Dagger

- Postgres

- JOOQ

- BigQuery

- Kubernetes

- Terraform

Logistics

Location:  Remote (US) or San Mateo, CA, with occasional travel for team offsites and key meetings

Reports to:  Chief Marketing Officer

Education:  Bachelor's degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and experience

We encourage you to apply even if you don't meet every single qualification. Strong candidates rarely check every box, and we'd rather meet you than miss you.
How we're different

We stand for the side hustlers, the creators, the freelancers, and the investors — people who are not afraid to take on challenges, especially when it comes to their finances. Step is focused on disrupting the banking industry by delivering a differentiated, mobile-first consumer experience, and we operate like the customers we serve: customer obsessed, acting as owners, moving with urgency, and breaking the norm.

Step is a wholly owned subsidiary of  Beast Industries , the media and entertainment company founded by Jimmy Donaldson (MrBeast), the most-watched person in the world. Beast Industries spans digital media, consumer products, philanthropy, and new ventures, with an audience reach no consumer company has ever had — and Step is tasked with turning that reach into financial literacy and tools for the next generation at massive scale. With Beast's distribution and brand behind it, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12 months, and joining now means helping shape that trajectory from the inside.

Come work with us!

Step is a remote-first company building banking for the next generation. We offer competitive compensation and stock options, generous medical, dental, vision, and company-paid life insurance, a 401k plan with Safe Harbor company matching, a flexible vacation policy and paid company holidays, 12 weeks paid parental leave with flexible return to work, and a company-provided technology package. As we grow, we’re looking for a Head of Compliance to lead and scale our compliance program across the full spectrum of applicable banking, lending and payments regulations. This is a unique opportunity for someone who brings deep regulatory knowledge and the willingness to get into the details—rolling up their sleeves to build, maintain, and evolve a compliance function that enables innovation, trust, and long-term impact. As part of Beast Industries, MrBeast's family of companies, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12-24 months, and this role will directly support that growth by successfully guiding Step through the current and upcoming regulatory landscape..

In this role, you will:

- Serve as Step’s compliance leader and subject matter expert across all key banking and financial services regulations, including but not limited to: BSA/AML, KYC, UDAAP, Reg E, Reg Z, EFTA, GLBA, FCRA, and CFPB guidance

- Own and drive the compliance strategy, ensuring that Step’s products, partnerships, and operations meet regulatory requirements and industry best practices

- Develop, enhance, and execute policies and procedures that support a risk-based, scalable compliance program

- Collaborate closely with Product, Engineering, Risk, Customer Experience, Marketing, Legal and our partner banks to support compliant product development and delivery

- Oversee internal reviews, audits, testing, training, and ongoing monitoring efforts

- Lead compliance management processes such as issue tracking, regulatory exams, complaints handling, and reporting

- Evaluate new regulations and regulatory changes, and translate them into actionable plans and guidance

- Serve as the primary compliance point of contact with regulators, partner banks, auditors, and other key stakeholders

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- 10+ years of experience in compliance, legal within fintech, banking, and/or payments—ideally across both startup and regulated environments

- Deep and broad understanding of U.S. consumer financial services regulation, with specific fluency in deposit, payments, and lending frameworks

- Experience working with sponsor banks or in BaaS partnerships, and a strong understanding of the nuances of shared compliance models

jobs.title: Head of Risk
jobs.description:
About Step

Step's mission is to improve the financial future of the next generation. Millions of people use our banking and borrowing products to manage, build, and grow their money. Now that we're part of Beast Industries – the company behind MrBeast – we're poised for a new phase of growth to deliver financial literacy and tools at massive scale.

About the Role

We're looking for a Head of Risk to lead our Risk team, partnering with Product, Engineering, Compliance and Data teams to own risk decisioning, scaling risk operations and minimizing fraud losses. You'll lead our high-performing risk team to drive decisions covering transactional risk, first party fraud, targeted fraud attacks, ATO risk and is no stranger to making difficult decisions delivering both great customer experiences, while also mitigating fraud. As part of Beast Industries, MrBeast's family of companies, Step is positioned to scale significantly over the next 12-24 months, and deliver best in class risk controls and protection will be critical to support that growth.

In this role, you will:

- Lead Step’s Risk strategy that balances aggressive fraud mitigation with a frictionless, world-class user experience

- Champion cross-functional partnership with Data Science, Product, Engineering, and Compliance to embed risk-aware decisioning into the product lifecycle

- Own Step’s fraud loss outcomes by partnering with Finance to balance revenue growth against risk overhead and operational costs

- Scale the Risk organization to meet hyper-growth demands, prioritizing automated, technical-first solutions to improve operational efficiency

- Drive continuous improvement of risk prediction models to minimize false positives and enhance precision in high-stakes environments

- Execute a customer-centric risk culture that views every mitigation effort through the lens of user trust and retention

You might thrive in this role if you have:

- 10+ years of high-impact risk leadership, with a strong preference for candidates offering expertise in risk analytics and/or data science

- Proven track record of analytical leadership, using data to navigate complex challenges and drive strategic business results

- Extensive experience within Fintech or Banking, specifically managing high-risk consumer technology environments and payment platforms

- Demonstrated success in neutralising transactional fraud while maintaining full accountability for fraud losses.

- Expertise in developing defense strategies against sophisticated attack vectors, including first-party and friendly fraud

- History of collaborating with Product teams to deliver seamless, "good-customer" experiences without compromising security

- Proactive, outcome-oriented mindset with a deep commitment to advocating for the customer at every decision point

- Mastery of cross-functional influence, building consensus and alignment across disparate internal teams and stakeholders

- Extensive experience building and mentoring multi-disciplinary teams across Risk Ops, Analytics, Disputes, and Investigations
